audit027-B02.accepted_final:
L'extension $\mathcal E=\mathcal E_{0,3}$ de $\Gamma=\Gamma_{0,3}\simeq\underbrace{\unsure{\mathfrak S|\mathcal S}_{\unsure{[|\{}0,1,\infty]}}_{\unsure{=|\simeq}\unsure{\mathfrak S_3|\mathcal S_3}}\times\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z$
\margin{engendré par $\tau:\ z\mapsto\bar z$}
par
\[
\Pi=\Pi_{0,3}=\{l_0,l_1,l_\infty\mid l_\infty l_1l_0=1\}=\Pi_1(\underbrace{\mathbb P^1_{\mathbb C}\setminus\{0,1,\infty\}}_{U=U_{0,3}},-\bar{\jmath}\}.
\]
audit027-B02.accepted_adjudication: Qualify the short underbrace relation; retain U=U0,3, capital Pi, the mismatched closing brace and the undotted barred j.
audit027-B02.accepted_ink: Before the small ornate S3 label, the relation has a short dark point/stroke and a longer low stroke, insufficient to exclude a weak upper wave; equals remains preferred with simeq as an alternative. The lower label’s second letter has two sides joined below, unlike the clear crossed X on the next lines, so U=U0,3 is retained. All three Pi signs have a cap and two full descending posts. The base point has a separate minus, long j stem with lower loop and one upper bar, with no extra dot; dotless j under the bar is a serialization correction. The final delimiter has a middle kink and lower foot and remains a right brace despite the opening parenthesis.

audit027-B05.accepted_final: $\unsure{\deleted{\unsure{\dot\rho^2}}|\unsure{\dot\rho|\rho}^{\deleted{\unsure{2}}}}\tau,\dot\sigma_0\tau,\dot\sigma_1\tau,\dot\sigma_\infty\tau$. Les p\textsuperscript{ts} fixes de $\rho$ \inserted{\unsure{sont}} $P$ et $\bar P$ dont le stabilisateur est d'ordre $6$, \inserted{savoir $\varphi(\unsure{\mathfrak S_3|\mathcal S_3})$}
audit027-B05.accepted_adjudication: Record the high2-like remnant and uncertain scope of cancellation before tau; retain the two separate prose insertions and raise the abbreviated ts.
audit027-B05.accepted_ink: The rho-like head before the first tau is densely retraced, while its long descender survives. A separate high curved/angled remnant to its right can be read as2. The ink does not securely distinguish cancellation of the whole rho-squared prefix from cancellation of the raised2 alone, so both states are explicit; the whole-prefix cancellation remains preferred. The dot on rho is also uncertain. The later undotted rho has no dot above its open loop. Sont is a small separate insertion after that rho, while the guide under savoir phi(S3) returns after ordre6, not before P. In pts, the small t/s letters stand above the p baseline and are set raised.

audit027-B06.accepted_adjudication: Resolve Pi in Pi-conjugués as capital; retain the written1,2,3 indices and both insertion attachments.
audit027-B06.accepted_ink: The conjugacy letter has a horizontal cap and two distinct full-height posts, comparable with the three opening Pi forms. The darker lower feet are retracing and do not remove that structure, so the local lower-case alternative is resolved. In the preceding list the three sigma indices are a straight1, curved2 and double-lobed3, all with separate over-dots. audit027-B07.accepted_adjudication: Remove the separate comma before s’obtiennent, broaden the old qui/et word and qualify the dark1 in the later list. Retain both élémt abbreviations and au dessus.
audit027-B07.accepted_ink: After Pbar there is no separate punctuation before the small curved initial s of s’obtiennent and its high apostrophe. The hook previously assigned as a comma belongs to that initial word, so it is not duplicated. Both élémt forms have compressed middle strokes and a terminal t rather than a fully written ment sequence. The old word before live qui has a loop and dense cross-strokes that allow qui or et. The later soit/sont remains uncertain; au has a low rounded a and u before the separate dessus.
